selection.reason: R148 is the consolidated light-signalling device regulation covering the rear position, stop and reversing lamp functions in this module, including photometry and colour.
The integrated PMMA prism retro-reflector must be approved as a retro-reflective device under the consolidated R150, which replaces R3.
R48 governs the number, position, geometric visibility and electrical connection of rear position, stop, reversing lamps and rear retro-reflectors on M1 vehicles.
The LED modules on a PCB, with any driver electronics, make the lamp an electrical/electronic sub-assembly subject to EMC emission and immunity requirements.
The rear lamp forms part of the outer surface of an M1 vehicle, so its lens and housing edges must meet external projection requirements.
verworfen (Annahme, nicht in der Spec): R128 would apply only if the lamp used replaceable standardised LED light sources instead of the non-replaceable LED modules described.
Superseded by the consolidated R148, which covers position and stop lamps.
Superseded by the consolidated R148, which covers reversing lamps.
Superseded by the consolidated R150, which covers retro-reflectors.
Covers retro-reflective markings for M2, M3, N and O vehicles, not M1 lamp retro-reflectors, and is consolidated into R150.
The specification includes no rear fog lamp function.
